records.Close_or_COM_release_coverage: not instrumented: no runtime proof of every Close or COM release

cpp_diff.differences: Trace adds fixed numeric poll/arrival/lifetime storage and timestamps, changing scheduling overhead; original acquisition/wait/buffer/timeline remain.

limitation: Per-frame poll/readback observations cannot observe empty polling or callbacks in the nontrace run. A long unobserved interval cannot assign CPU, engine, compositor, WGC or driver cause.
